provenance: Small curated synthetic commerce benchmark, held out from classifier fitting and retrieval indexing. Reference SQL authored before inference runs. Not a public benchmark or production accuracy estimate.

cases.question: Give me a single number for revenue earned after refunds across all completed purchases.
List net sales for each calendar month in chronological order.
cases.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date), ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Compare net revenue for Web, Mobile, and Partner, highest revenue first.
cases.sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) FROM orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 2 DESC

cases.question: Which customer regions brought in the most net revenue? List every region and its revenue in descending order.
cases.sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY 2 DESC

cases.question: Name the top 3 customers by net revenue and show each customer's revenue.
cases.sql: SELECT c.customer_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.customer_name ORDER BY 2 DESC,c.customer_name LIMIT 3

cases.question: How much net revenue did orders placed in January 2025 generate?
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue),2) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-02-01'

cases.question: Calculate total net revenue from the Web channel only.
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue),2) FROM orders WHERE channel='Web'

cases.question: How many Mobile orders have cancelled status?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE channel='Mobile' AND status='cancelled'

cases.question: What is the average net order value for completed Partner orders?
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(net_revenue),2) FROM orders WHERE channel='Partner' AND status='completed'

cases.question: Count completed orders placed by customers in the North region.
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.region='North' AND o.status='completed'

cases.question: What percentage of gross completed-order dollars did we refund?
How many distinct customers placed at least one completed order?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

refusal_cases.question: Calculate profit after shipping costs and taxes.
Predict exactly how much revenue we will make in 2027.
